title: speech block props
description: A character (« Personnage »): a speaker of the course says something to the learner, in bubbles beside its portrait. Its name, colour and look come from course.json speakers (an SVG character or a portrait picture; without a look, its initial). Several lines are several bubbles, one under the other. kind thought draws them as a thought.
x-ai-instructions: Use a character to give a voice to someone the learner will meet (a colleague who asks, a client who complains, an expert who warns), or a guide who frames a page in a conversational tone, in one to three short lines (a sentence or two each). It is not a dialogue: nothing to choose (for choices, use a dialogue block). The speaker must be in course.json speakers, with a name and ideally a look; the same character keeps one side (side) in a module. Write what the character says in its own words, never the lesson's text in quotes.

speaker.description: A speaker of course.json speakers: its name, colour and look.

lines.description: What the character says, a bubble per line, in order.

id.description: Stable id of the line (translations name it).

markdown.description: The line, one or two sentences.

side.description: Where the portrait is: start (left in left-to-right languages) or end, the bubbles beside it.

kind.description: speech: speech bubbles; thought: thought bubbles (what the character thinks, not says).
